node.statement: Multiplier control from def-epsilon-cstar-algebra: if V lies in calUbar_r with r<=1/4, then (1-epsilon_r)||V||^2<=||V^dagger bold-dot V||<=1+2r, so ||V|| is universally bounded. For every Z, approximate associativity and ||V^dagger bold-dot V-J||<=2r give ||L_{V^dagger}L_V Z-Z||<=C*(epsilon_r+r)||Z||. After decreasing the universal guard this norm is <=1/4, whence L_V is injective; finite dimensionality plus the right inverse required in def-approximate-unitary-space (or simply equal dimensions for injective endomorphisms) makes it invertible, and ||L_V^{-1}||<=C. The same argument applies to every point within O(delta) of such V. All constants C here and below are absolute because only a fixed number of inequalities from def-epsilon-cstar-algebra is used.
